topic: Is the Cat Bells walk in the Lake District open all year, and how long does the main route take?

text: Anyone up for cat bells tomorrow? Weather looks ok in the morning 🤞
Is it open all year? Ive never checked. And how long is the main route do you reckon
Open all year as far as I know, no closures unless its really bad. Main route prob 2.5-3hrs return from hawse end
In. Hawse end car park fills up fast on sundays so earlier is better
Wind drops after 9 apparently so morning's the window
Wait is hawse end the one by the lake or the other one
Hawse end is the car park up the road from portinscale, not the lake one. Brandelhow is the lakeside option, a bit further to walk in
Ok hawse end. I'll drive and collect u at 7:45 ellie?
[photo: sunset over Skiddaw from my kitchen]
Bed soon. Forecast still looks ok so see u both at 7:45 🥾
